categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies core serialization primitives in src/serialize.h, stream utilities in src/streams.{h,cpp}, and cryptographic SHA-256 helpers in src/crypto/sha256.{h,cpp}.
categories.rationale: The PR optimizes serialization primitives by adding single-byte read/write overloads and modernizing integer size computation with C++20 concepts. Microbenchmarks show 10–25% latency improvements on block serialization routines and ~2% in IBD benchmarks, though reviewers note production impact on IBD may be limited because stream writes are already buffered.
